scope: Exactly 54 reserved PSYC 21 / CRIM 17 / LEAD 16 identifiers, every full actual course card opened and read. No prerequisite-chain expansion, root-language overlap, inferred identity merge or seed/ledger edit. Semester unit normalization cites the separately reviewed D01.4 policy; each amount is independently printed on its own card. Runtime observations never emit manual category reviews.

notes: No prerequisite field is published in this inspected card; this does not establish unrestricted enrollment.

category_review.rationale: The course explicitly examines institutions, social actors, historical change and ethics.
